progress_assessment: Approximate full-port estimate, up from 20%, within an assessed 28-35% range. The function worklist is complete: all 4510 patched game-code functions are cited, 4491 of them with 8-digit translation citations (144 of those so far only as callees), and the port's own engine loads real scenarios, places and builds buildings, selects units, gathers, fights and draws authentic scenes (this image is one of them). Still unfinished: wiring the translated screens and the world into one game loop (the Game Screen drives only part of it), computer players driving the world, scenario victory and defeat, saving and loading games, the SceAudio sound backend and music, multiplayer, and validation against the original game and on Vita hardware, performance included.
effort_assessment: Eight builders at the Wonder represent the high effort setting for this reporting period (the Game Screen, placement and selection work), not eight people or a measured number of work hours.
